For a 50-person Indian company, the real cost is mostly transaction/service fees plus supplier cancellation charges, rather than a simple monthly subscription.

Provider	Total-cost picture	Cancellation / exclusions	Support
MMT myBiz	Quote-based service fee per order + fare/hotel price + GST. 1.5% payment-gateway fee applies to wallet/card repayments. 
MakeMyTrip
	No universal cancellation policy: airline/hotel supplier rules apply. MMT describes its service largely “as-is”, unless your contract specifies otherwise. 
MakeMyTrip
	Self-serve platform + corporate support.
Cleartrip OOO	₹0 subscription / platform fee publicly advertised; booking prices and supplier charges still apply. 
OOO
	Verify airline/hotel cancellation, reissue and service charges before contracting.	Corporate reporting, approvals, GST and stated round-the-clock support. 
OOO

Thomas Cook India	Custom quote; negotiate transaction/management fees and credit terms.	Supplier cancellation/reissue costs need to be passed through; scope can include air, hotels, rail, forex, visas and MICE. 
Thomas Cook
	24×7 emergency desk, dedicated corporate servicing and SLA-backed service. 
Thomas Cook

FCM India	Custom quote; get management + transaction + implementation fees itemised.	Cancellation can be up to 100% of booking cost; changes/reissues can add fees. Refunds may wait until FCM receives supplier funds. 
FCM Travel
	Managed travel model; negotiate explicit SLA and after-hours coverage.
What I’d put in the RFQ

Ask each for a 12-month all-in quote based on your actual expected travel spend, with: per-booking fee, hotel fee, cancellation/reissue fee, GST, payment fees, after-hours fee, implementation fee, credit period and SLA.

For a 50-person company, don't compare “₹0 subscription” against managed TMC pricing directly. The decisive number is your effective cost per trip after servicing and change/cancellation fees.
